def fast_exponentiation(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    base %= mod
    while exp > 0:
        if (exp & 1) == 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

    range_ = R - L + 1
    mod = 998244353

    if total % 2 == 1:
        result = fast_exponentiation(range_, total, mod)
    elif range_ % 2 == 0:
        result = (fast_exponentiation(range_, total, mod) * (mod + 1) // 2) % mod
    else:
        result = ((fast_exponentiation(range_, total, mod) + 1) * (mod + 1) // 2) % mod

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
